predecessors.detail: The lab signing key is written down in the build notes and is not imported here. gpgcheck=1 before that key exists stops every install from this repo.
localpkg_gpgcheck fails closed the same way when the signing key was never imported.

depends_on.because: The mission host passes GPG checking and installs from the lab repo. The repo host still publishes packages with gpgcheck off, so this pass does not cover the packages.
